name: Ethena USDe
oneLiner: USDe is a synthetic dollar that stays near $1 by hedging crypto collateral with equal short positions; funding yield accrues to sUSDe stakers.
collateral: Predominantly liquid stablecoins (~77%: USDtb by Ethena backed by BlackRock BUIDL, plus USDC, USDT, pyUSD, and yield-bearing variants deposited in Aave/Morpho) as non-hedged backing; remainder in delta-neutral positions — BTC (~16%) and ETH/stETH (~8%) spot long + equal short perpetual futures on CEXes (Binance, Bybit, OKX)
pegMechanism: Delta-neutral hedging: spot collateral custodied off-exchange (Copper, Ceffu, Anchorage Digital, Kraken) with equal short perpetual positions on CEXes (Binance, Bybit, OKX)

oracleRisk.summary: Ethena's offchain hedging system prices mint and redeem requests from exchange market data and validates internal pricing with Pyth and RedStone, but USDe has no permissionless CDP liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDe is minted and redeemed through signed orders accepted by Ethena's offchain pricing and hedging services, while backing assets are paired with centrally managed derivatives hedges. It does not expose user CDP markets with per-collateral onchain liquidation thresholds, liquidation auctions, backstops, or shutdown branches, so the V9 collateral-liquidation branch families do not apply.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: POSTURE CHANGE on 2026-07-22: direct holder control is Yes because the material TON USDe jetton can be locked by its administrator. Ethereum USDe exposes owner-set minter authority and ordinary ERC-20 transfers but no holder freeze or blacklist, and a finalized Solana read at slot 434568679 returned freezeAuthority=null. On TON, verified jetton-minter.fc code for EQAIb6KmdfdDR7CN1GBqVJuP25iCnLKCvBlJ07Evuu2dzP5f gives the administrator an upgrade path and an admin-only call_to operation that can send set_status to any derived jetton wallet; the verified source explicitly describes this path as able to lock, unlock, or redeem funds. The 2026-07-22 state was pinned to master code hash a9bfedc76d60b332e8019e405505aadf4d7f870b8d3bae7abcfeb868681e6b2a and last transaction LT 91438387000020 / hash bf7da7303ee7eb1ac66741c08f6ba5146fc6fdde56206118f6801b30673f2727, with administrator EQCrj-smMj6JQCAvb-BPwlMa71IAA7pK3KNaFcVOdeYC6qS7. This TON holder-control path makes the asset-level direct posture true even though the reviewed Ethereum and Solana deployments lack an equivalent active freeze authority.

mintAuthority.summary: USDe minting uses signed-order flows through the EthenaMinting contract. At Ethereum block 25711751, the one-day TimelockController owned the USDe token and held the active minter contract's default-admin role; the 5/10 Ethena Safe held its proposer, canceller, and executor roles.

That custom replacement path can substitute the mint-critical controller without upgrading token bytecode, so it is modeled separately as the upgrade-only authority referenced by upgradeability.controlRef.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711751: USDe minter() returned EthenaMinting V2 0xe3490297; owner() returned timelock 0xe8dc0fab; getMinDelay() returned 86400; the timelock held EthenaMinting V2 DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; and the 5/10 Safe held its PROPOSER_ROLE, CANCELLER_ROLE, and EXECUTOR_ROLE. The Safe still had no enabled modules, and Safe API reported guard 0x74abe7805541c28f31953b3cda9711dc96278d29. globalConfig() remained a 200,000,000 USDe global mint maximum per block and a 10,000,000 USDe global redeem maximum per block. Complete RoleGranted and RoleRevoked replay through block 25576200 resolved the 20 MINTER_ROLE EOAs recorded in the signer-cohort control; incremental Blockscout queries returned zero RoleGranted and zero RoleRevoked events from block 25576201 through 25711751, establishing that the cohort remained current at the observation block. Ethena's latest reviewed publication, issued July 1, 2026 for June 2026, describes the nineteenth monthly report from all integrated custodians and an independent third-party assessment of backing assets; the monthly reconciliation therefore qualifies as periodic. Searches of the BVI FSC and Dubai VARA public registers did not establish prudential supervision of the USDe issuer, so supervision is attestation-only.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDe uses or is linked to LayerZero/OFT-style cross-chain token infrastructure. Because OFT/adapter routes depend on external messaging, endpoint configuration, and lock/mint or burn/mint token contracts outside issuer-native redemption alone, Pharos scores the reviewed route as external lock/mint.
